units.source_text: 正如将棋名人的争夺战一样，霸权的价值很重要，

en.t: Just as in the contest for the shogi Meijin title, the value of supremacy was highly important,

units.source_text: 名人的段位成了优胜奖旗似的称号，成了兴办体育比赛者的商品。

en.t: the rank of Meijin became a title like a championship banner, and became a commodity for those who promoted sporting contests.

units.source_text: 实际上也可以说名人已经用上一代未曾用过的对局费，把这次告别赛卖给了报社。

en.t: In fact, one could also say that the Meijin had sold this farewell match to the newspaper company for a game fee such as the previous generation had never used.

units.source_text: 与其说这是名人主动出卖，莫如说是被报社引诱了。

en.t: Rather than saying that the Meijin willingly sold it, it would be better to say that he was enticed by the newspaper company.

units.source_text: 这种一旦爬上名人地位，到死也是名人的终身制或段位制，

en.t: This kind of lifetime system or ranking system, in which once one climbs to the position of Meijin one remains Meijin until death,

units.source_text: 如同日本各种艺道的流派和师家的执照一样，是封建时代的遗物。

en.t: is, like the licenses of the schools and master houses in Japan's various arts, a relic of the feudal age.

units.source_text: 假使围棋名人要像现在的将棋名人那样年年举办争夺战，

en.t: If the go Meijin had had to hold a title contest every year like the present shogi Meijin,

units.source_text: 秀哉名人也许早已离开人世了。

en.t: Meijin Shusai might long since have passed from this world.
